module seqdet(input clk, input rst_n, input d, output reg hit);
  reg [2:0] s;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin s<=0; hit<=0; end
    else begin s <= {s[1:0], d}; hit <= (s==3'b101) & d; end
  end
endmodule
